name: liquid-glass-card
description: Real refraction, not just blur: a WebGL liquid glass card with a specular rim and bounce-in, for web, SwiftUI and Claude Design.

interface.shortDescription: Real-refraction liquid glass cards for web and SwiftUI
interface.longDescription: Build a polished liquid glass card from a one-line request: frosted, light-bending glass over a soft colour glow, with a specular rim and an overshoot bounce-in. Ships a self-contained WebGL template for the web, native Liquid Glass for SwiftUI, and a CSS tier for glass over live page content.
